basis: Vuls early consultation after dependency-only edit with no checked main repair; repeated incomplete verification; separate transport PATH defect already corrected with model-free evidence
mechanism: Consolidate general solving/verification once, separate voluntary routing from common policy, require observable attempt record or concrete early exception; self-contained source and verified integration
generality: No repository/task identifiers, expected patches, benchmark-specific triggers or hidden grades. Checks fit domain; no mandatory edits/tests for irrelevant tasks.
comparison: Same v7 common policy and corrected transport for Sol-only and router; routing guidance only where expert action is available. No forced review.
change_scope: Separately versioned backend; archivedv2/v3/v4/v6 prompts not stacked or modified; supported Codex/MCP transport, context-only expert and snapshot mechanism retained
risks: More stated rules may still not improve actual compliance
Independent work can waste budget or integration time
Compact packets can omit decisive context
Comparing different development tasks cannot establish causal prompt gain
falsification: Keep failures, premature requests, unsupported completion, unnecessary expert use and failed integration. Do not tune held-out outcomes.
